title: obs-sme
summary: A technical build-specification repository for an SME (small/medium enterprise) risk-assessment platform, detailing a Module 3 risk-scoring pipeline with feature engineering, XGBoost/LSTM training, and SHAP explainability. Its synthetic augmentation step, documented as ml/m3/synth.py, is designed to fit SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata and FixedCombinations/ScalarRange constraints to boost the scarce positive class before model training.
evidence: BUILD_09_Module3_Risk.md:271-280 shows fit_synthesizer(df) using GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, SingleTableMetadata, FixedCombinations/ScalarRange constraints
needs: Code appears only inside markdown build-spec docs (ml/m3/synth.py is documented, not present as an actual source file in the repo), so it's unclear whether this SDV usage was ever actually run.
